map.放养密度：每亩密度 = 总尾数 n ÷ 面积 area（尾/亩）、折合每平方米: Stocking density: density per mu = total count n ÷ area (fish/mu), equivalent per square meter = n ÷ (area×666.67) (fish/m²), both recorded as 0 when area ≤0; four cards echo the total count and area. Validation: non-numeric inputs are highlighted and participate as 0, and a history entry is recorded only when both values are valid. Grading: no fixed tiers; the mu and square-meter measures always move together by a factor of 666.67, and the larger the area the lower the density.
